title: Radiant Lift in Ocala, FL | RF Lifting | GLO Aesthetics
meta: Radiant Lift in Ocala, FL uses radiofrequency to tighten and contour the face and neck in 30–45 minutes with no downtime, from $500. Book a consult.
answer: Radiant Lift is GLO's non-invasive radiofrequency treatment that gently heats deeper skin layers to tighten and contour your face, jawline and neck. It suits mild-to-moderate laxity, tired-looking skin and preventive care. Sessions take 30–45 minutes with no downtime. You'll see a refresh right away, and results build over 3–6 months.
treats_intro: Radiant Lift treats mild-to-moderate skin laxity, a softening jawline and neck, and tired-looking skin. It's also a preventive option to help slow visible signs of aging.
how: Radiant Lift uses radiofrequency (RF) energy, not a laser, to gently heat the deeper layers of your skin without needles. That warmth tightens existing collagen fibers for a visible refresh right after treatment. It also starts your skin's natural repair response, so new collagen builds over the following 3–6 months for a firmer, more lifted look. We'll confirm whether Radiant Lift or Everesse suits your goals.
fit_h2: Is Radiant Lift right for me?
good_fit: You have mild-to-moderate loosening on your face, jawline or neck
Your skin looks tired and you'd like a natural-looking refresh
You want to stay ahead of visible aging with preventive care
You want a comfortable treatment with no needles and no downtime
not_fit: You have a pacemaker or another implanted electronic device
You have significant metal implants in the treatment area or you're pregnant
You'd like to treat body areas such as the knees or abdomen — Everesse skin tightening may be the better fit
Your main concern is sun damage, fine lines or acne scars — laser skin revitalization is usually the better fit
expect_h2: What happens during a Radiant Lift appointment?
expect_intro: A Radiant Lift session takes 30–45 minutes of gentle, comfortable radiofrequency heating. You'll see a visible refresh right away and can go straight back to your day.

faq_add.a: Radiant Lift is designed to be comfortable. Most people feel gentle warmth as the radiofrequency energy heats the deeper layers of skin. There are no needles, and you can go back to your day right after.

faq_add.q: How many Radiant Lift sessions do I need?
faq_add.a: It depends on your skin and goals. Your provider will recommend a plan at your consultation, including how often to come back for maintenance as collagen builds over the following 3–6 months.

faq_add.q: How long do Radiant Lift results last?
faq_add.a: You'll see a refresh right away, and results build over 3–6 months as new collagen forms. How long they last depends on your age, skin and lifestyle, since your skin keeps aging. Maintenance sessions can help. Results vary.
